## Historical audit: H0072

**Scope.** Only chunk 2 of 2 is visible. Citations below refer to source **H0072**, original file `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_07/lanes/codex_parallel_07_lane4/codex_parallel_07_lane4_H_r1/infer_logs/obsidian-linter-auto-table-of-contents/turn_1/trajs.json`; offsets are character ranges of the indicated decoded events.

**Inferred goal:** Add an Obsidian Linter rule that generates a configurable table of contents between markers. The original task instructions are not visible in this chunk, so the complete requirements cannot be established.

**Outcome:** Unknown, with a visible technical interruption and failed build; not an empty patch. Inventory metadata reports a 10,175-byte patch, missing evaluation, and an incomplete terminal reason. Neither formal success nor algorithm failure is established. The comment-related edit plausibly addresses the build transformation, but there is no visible rerun result confirming it; missing dependencies also remain unresolved in the visible record.

**Teacher input and adoption:** The inventory lists available hint files and a captured-system-prompt path, but their contents are not supplied here. No delivered teacher text or evidence of adoption is visible in this chunk; availability alone is not receipt. Earlier exploration and any other validation are likewise unknown.

**Lessons and uncertainty:** The transferable observation is that inspecting build transformations and dependency availability can distinguish separate failure sources. The whitespace-sensitive getter fix is specific to this build configuration. Heading-anchor compatibility, edge cases, idempotence and functional correctness remain untested hypotheses in the visible evidence.
